name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Dice the carrot and chop the broccoli into small pieces.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the vegetables until tender, about 5–7 minutes.
Push vegetables aside. Add beaten eggs and scramble until fully set.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce. Stir until everything is steaming hot and serve.

name: Vegetable Omelet
steps: Grate the carrot and finely chop the broccoli.
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet. Cook the vegetables until tender, about 5 minutes.
Beat eggs with salt and pour over the vegetables.
Cook over medium-low heat until the eggs are fully set, folding to serve.

name: Broccoli Rice Bowl
steps: Chop broccoli and thinly slice the carrot.
Heat oil in a skillet. Add vegetables and cook, stirring, until tender, about 8–10 minutes.
Add cooked rice and salt. Stir until steaming hot throughout.
